title: Version 1.66.0
body:
Version 1.66.0 (⛏️ The Mining Away Update! 💎)

August 30th, 2024

Added:

  • Mike's Mines have been entirely revamped, things are more open and enjoyable!
  • The mines now contain an inside water cove. Blue glow worms can be found around the walls within the cove. Collect them with jars for some quick cash or awesome decor!
  • An all new 'machine' is here, the composter! Provide all sorts of fruits and plants, and you'll receive this world's most VALUABLE material.... dirt. it's just dirt. it's all dirt. dirt. dirt. dirt. dirt.", "--- 🗺️ | I'm lost. Help me. ---", "A bunch of maps can now be found around.. the map! (try saying that 5 times fast) These should help new and old players navigate around the area, hopefully it'll make it easier to find where you're going.
  • Future plans for a minimap are being planned, no ETA on that yet!
  • A little special shop now sells a little special GREEN lantern. 💚🟢🟩🍏📗
  • Oaklands hit 20 MILLION visits... this means the return of the AMAZING classic materials. The following materials are returning: Classic Tree, Classic Cactus, Classic Purple Cactus, Oreable, Stone
  • A new classic material is also here, Classic Sand! It is found around the beach.
  • There is no ETA for when these will be removed, one will be provided soon, you'll have plenty of time!
  • Chat tips have been added to the game, you'll receive a random tip every 3 minutes.
  • There is 20 different tips in game so far (22 if you're 13+.. you should be..)
  • This can be disabled in the in-game settings.
  • THREE new creator codes have been added to the game. These all give you awesome signs, and you can find the codes from the creators (or you can try to guess them... 😔 at least subscribe!)
  • BunnyFilms, Dalib Gresser, and CodePrime8 all have awesome creator codes. Check out their channels!
  • ⏺️ | Vinyl Creator
  • This costs Robux, sorry.
  • An experimental Vinyl Creator has been added above the Oak Depot. This is still heavily work in progress and will change drastically.
  • Awesome artist Pixelates has created a thumbnail for Oaklands. Super awesome, thought I would share, it's GREAT.

Notes:

  • Some of the team, myself included, is going to the Roblox Developer Convention in a few days! This will result in no updates or sneak peeks from us while we are gone. (Inverted and Jak might have some stuff to share though!)
  • We might be doing an IRL live stream, would be fun if you want to ask some questions about Oaklands!

Version 1.66.1

August 30th, 2024

Added:

  • Mike's Mines now has a map!

Fixed:

  • Issues with the map have been fixed
  • Some issues with sound regions should be fixed

Version 1.66.2

August 30th, 2024

Fixed:

  • Fixed an issue where the slot menu would not say any slots were there

Version 1.66.3

September 1st, 2024

Added:

  • A new base preset has been added, the Advanced Warehouse! Created by Azylo and 20Chetti01

Fixed:

  • Fixed the vials not being able to be picked up
  • Fixed a typo in a tip
  • Fixed being able to buy non-working ids from the vinyl machine, support for changing existing vinyls will be added soon
